description: This is a PHP class file defining a validation rule 'LessThanOrEqual' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It implements logic to check if an input value is less than or equal to a target object, which can be a closure, DateTime, float, or int.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqual
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if an input value is less than or equal to a specified target object, which can be a closure, DateTime, float, or int.

methods.name: __construct

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is less than or equal to the target object, evaluating callables and converting inputs to DateTime when applicable.
